note: A compact USB3 Vision camera; the data sheet covers the colour (U-240c, entered) and mono (U-240m) models. Sold without a lens, so no FOV, f-number or focus is stated: the imager has no FOV and the library uses its labelled default until the user enters the chosen lens (or a calibration). Sony IMX392, 1936 x 1216, global shutter, sensor "6.7 x 4.2 mm (7.9 mm, Type 1/2.3)", pixel 3.45 um. Maximum frame rate 176 fps; the data sheet does not say for which pixel format. RGB8 is the default colour format (BGR8, YCbCr and Bayer also listed), but 1936 x 1216 at 176 fps in RGB8 (24 bits per pixel) would be 9.9 Gbit/s, about twice USB 3.1 Gen 1's 5 Gbit/s signalling, so the maximum cannot be an RGB8 rate: the stream's format and bits per pixel are null (not stated for that rate; truthfulness review 2026-11-07, data sheet read again). Exposure 23 us to 10 s. power_w is the typical figure with USB power, 2.8 W (3.0 W with external power). size_mm: 38 x 29 x 29 mm (L x W x H), L along the optical axis; C-, CS- or S-mount. Four programmable GPIOs (trigger use not stated, so sync is null).
